# mondoo_integration_azure_devops_repos (Resource)

Continuously scan Azure DevOps repositories: every repository of an Azure DevOps organization, or one repository when `project` and `repository` are set. Create it in a Mondoo organization (`org_id`), whose routing rules place the assets into spaces, or in a space (`space_id`). Authenticates as a Microsoft Entra app registration, with a client secret or a certificate.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "client_secret" {
  description = "Client secret of the Microsoft Entra app registration"
  type        = string
  sensitive   = true
}

# Scan every repository of an Azure DevOps organization, from the Mondoo organization
resource "mondoo_integration_azure_devops_repos" "organization" {
  org_id               = "your-org-1234567"
  name                 = "Azure DevOps: acme"
  organization         = "acme"
  repository_deny_list = ["archive-*"]
  secret_scan          = true
  vulnerability_scan   = true

  credentials = {
    tenant_id     = "ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff"
    client_id     = "ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff"
    client_secret = var.client_secret
  }
}

# Scan one repository, from a space, authenticating with a certificate
resource "mondoo_integration_azure_devops_repos" "repository" {
  space_id     = "hungry-poet-123456"
  name         = "Azure DevOps: acme/web/api"
  organization = "acme"
  project      = "web"
  repository   = "api"
  code_scan    = true

  credentials = {
    tenant_id   = "ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff"
    client_id   = "ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff"
    certificate = file("${path.module}/mondoo-ado.pem")
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials` (Attributes) Microsoft Entra app registration to authenticate as. Set exactly one of `client_secret` and `certificate`; switching between them replaces the integration. Mondoo checks the credentials against Azure DevOps before it saves the integration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--credentials))
- `name` (String) Name of the integration.
- `organization` (String) Azure DevOps organization name: the `acme` in `https://dev.azure.com/acme`. Changing it replaces the integration.

### Optional

- `code_scan` (Boolean) Scan the source code (SAST). Defaults to `false`.
- `discover_k8s_manifests` (Boolean) Discover Kubernetes manifests in the repositories. Defaults to `false`.
- `discover_terraform` (Boolean) Discover Terraform files in the repositories. Defaults to `false`.
- `org_id` (String) Mondoo organization identifier. Set this to create the integration in the organization. Conflicts with `space_id`.
- `project` (String) Project of the one repository to scan. Set together with `repository`. Leave both unset to scan the whole organization. Changing it replaces the integration.
- `repository` (String) The one repository to scan, by name. Set together with `project`. Changing it replaces the integration.
- `repository_allow_list` (List of String) Scan only the repositories matching these glob patterns. Whole-organization mode only.
- `repository_deny_list` (List of String) Scan all repositories except the ones matching these glob patterns. Whole-organization mode only.
- `secret_scan` (Boolean) Detect secrets in the repositories. Defaults to `false`.
- `space_id` (String) Mondoo space identifier. If neither `space_id` nor `org_id` is set, the provider space is used.
- `vulnerability_scan` (Boolean) Scan dependencies for vulnerabilities (SCA). Defaults to `false`.

### Read-Only

- `mrn` (String) Integration identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `credentials`

Required:

- `client_id` (String) Application (client) ID of the app registration.
- `tenant_id` (String) Entra tenant (directory) ID.

Optional:

- `certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM bundle with the certificate uploaded to the app registration and its unencrypted RSA private key.
- `client_secret` (String, Sensitive) Client secret of the app registration.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import using integration MRN. The client secret or certificate is never read
# back: set it in the configuration, and the next apply sends it.
terraform import mondoo_integration_azure_devops_repos.organization "//captain.api.mondoo.app/organizations/your-org-1234567/integrations/2Abd08lk860"
```
